summary: Kartoon Studios filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a commercial arrangement with Walmart Marketplace to offer consumer products—toys, books, apparel and others—sourced from licensees and based on its animated series HUNDRED ACRE WOOD, derived from A.A. Milne's Winnie the Pooh, beginning January 18, 2027, with products expected concurrently with the series release. The filing contains forward-looking statements and is signed by CEO Andy Heyward. No securities transaction, ownership stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; the event is an ordinary distribution partnership, not a special situation, with execution and licensee sell-through as the watch items.
